definition: Revenue minus cost of goods sold (COGS)
example: $2.45M revenue - $1.79M COGS = $660K gross profit in June 2024

definition: Revenue minus all expenses including operating costs and taxes
Percentage of revenue retained as profit after expenses
Day-to-day costs of running the business excluding COGS
formula: Sum of Salaries + Marketing + Operations + G&A + R&D

definition: Difference between budgeted and actual spending
example: Engineering Q3 2024: $1.95M actual vs $1.8M budget = -$150K variance (over budget)

definition: Percentage change in revenue between two periods
Earnings before interest taxes depreciation and amortization
formula: Net Income + Interest + Taxes + Depreciation + Amortization
example: Approximately 28-32% of revenue for AnyCompany in 2024

definition: Annual Recurring Revenue - annualized value of subscription contracts
example: Cloud Subscriptions ARR: ~$3.0M based on Q4 2024 run rate

definition: Customer Acquisition Cost - cost to acquire a new customer
formula: Total Sales & Marketing Spend / New Customers Acquired
example: Tracked quarterly by the Sales and Marketing teams

definition: Customer Lifetime Value - total revenue expected from a customer
formula: Average Revenue per Customer × Average Customer Lifespan
example: Enterprise customers average 4.2 year lifespan at AnyCompany

definition: Rate at which the company spends cash reserves

example: Reviewed monthly by the CFO and Finance team

definition: Capital Expenditure - spending on long-term assets
formula: Purchases of property plant and equipment
